name: Lovelings
text: Round animals with a heart on their face and their tongue out.

name: Joylings
text: The silly ones. Each has one odd thing and sees nothing strange about it.

name: Monsterlings
text: Small monsters who were meant to be scary. It did not work.

name: PeepPops
text: Fuzzy creatures with too many eyes, or just one. They see everything.

name: UniPops
text: One horn, one feeling, turned all the way up.

name: Poopies
text: What is left when the day is done. Very relaxed about it.

name: POPeyes
text: Little suns with one big eye and white gloves that never stop waving.
